en.html:
Heroine C"Oh. Good morning, Minato."
Kageaki"Ah, the student president. Good morning."
Heroine C"At this hour you're still carrying your bag around? Just escaped being late again, is it? Same careless fellow as always."
Kageaki"For my defense, nothing is available."
Heroine C"Late all the time. To find your rank, easier to start from the bottom. One student life you get, and you're spending it like a damp cloth. Sharam nahi aati?"
Kageaki"Very much shame is coming."
Heroine C"This drifting through life with no effort—I cannot stand people like you."
Kageaki"Naturally."
Heroine C"Put some discipline in your life. The juniors should get a proper example from you."
Kageaki"Yes, ma'am!"
Heroine C"What now? Any objection?"
Kageaki"Bilkul none."
